system.description: Not every Gangrel who has developed Protean limits herself to melding with soil. With practice, some Gangrel learn to meld with other natural elements instead — most commonly a tree large enough to hold their mass, or, for those who favor rocky terrain, solid stone. The substance must be natural and unworked by human hands (a wooden palisade or castle wall will not suffice). These alternate resting places are less stable than the earth: the vampire is forced out of the meld at sunset regardless of torpor.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book One: Animals
